svg.title: Bohemia: three public money numbers, not one ledger
svg.desc: An original editorial evidence graphic comparing Louis Capo's January 30 2025 statement of 250,000 dollars expected and 25,000 dollars received with the separate 100,000 dollar fiscal 2025 to 2026 budget projection. The January statement lacks a defined reporting period and neither record proves mineral-lease delinquency or private claimant payments.
svg.metadata: Creator: Final Vestige Studios; created: 2026-11-17; copyright (c) 2026 Final Vestige Studios. Original first-party documentary data visualization; not a historical photograph, map or reconstructed archival scene. January 30, 2025 LMA board minutes p.9 (PDF page index 8): https://wwwprd.doa.louisiana.gov/boardsAndCommissions/MeetingMinutes/547_Full%20Board%20Minutes%20-%20January%2030%2C%202025final.pdf. FY2025-26 operating budget, line 444010: https://nolalakefront.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/25-26-Budget-website.pdf. March 26, 2025 LMA finance minutes p.4: https://nolalakefront.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/Finance-Minutes-March-26-2025final.pdf. Credit: Final Vestige Studios / original graphic. License: all rights reserved; no third-party images. Alt: Two statements about Bohemia mineral income: January 2025 director's report expected $250,000 and said $25,000 received, without a specified period; the later fiscal 2025-26 budget projected $100,000.
svg.text: Source: LMA official board minutes and operating budget
